bearerAuth.description: WorkOS mode requires the configured AuthKit human access JWT and current organization membership, a Connect human access token issued to an allowlisted standard client for this API's own resource (its permissions are the person's current permissions narrowed by the client's ceiling, in the organization the request names in `Omnigraph-Organization`, else the token's `org_id`), or the explicitly configured organization-owned M2M profile. Machine service authority is current WorkOS application scopes intersected with the signed token ceiling; machines cannot administer organization members. WorkOS service permissions authorize organization-wide service operations; applied Cedar owns native permissions. Login, refresh and client-credentials exchange occur at WorkOS. Development mode accepts its explicitly configured local bearer. Graph identity credentials cannot authenticate control requests.

info.description: Managed cluster identity, immutable native configuration previews, asynchronous delivery and cloud lifecycle operations. Source access and admission permit delivery; applied native policy authorizes effects. A 202 response acknowledges durable preview, delivery or lifecycle intent, not native acceptance or convergence. Poll the returned preview, deployment or operation. JSON bodies default to 2 MiB, except configuration upload (32 MiB) and identity issuance (64 KiB). Native graph/control HTTP is a separate service.
